scope: Code and canonical documentation audit; no implementation fixes, installations, service startup, dataset/model downloads or full ML jobs.
verdict: Scaffold with useful architecture direction; not ready for full-data runs or independent subsystem implementation until core correctness and contract issues are resolved.

compose_config.limitation: Only configuration parsing checked; Docker emitted access-denied warnings reading user config. No services started.

syntax.method: ast.parse over src, spark_jobs, scripts and tests

runtime_limits: No raw dataset present at data/raw.
No FastAPI, Spark, LightGBM, Transformers, Qdrant or ONNX inference integration run.
Mock-based probes verify wrapper behavior, not third-party backend execution.
Source inspection is distinguished from execution below.

findings.title: Validation-week boundary is wrong
findings.evidence: floor((t_dat - 2018-09-20)/7) assigns 2020-09-16 to 103 and 2020-09-17..22 to 104. Week-based train/validation filters would include the first validation day in train week 103.
findings.recommendation: Define one date-to-week function anchored to the specified validation interval; test every boundary and filter features by explicit cutoff date.

findings.title: LambdaRank groups merge independent prediction weeks
findings.evidence: Captured Dataset groups are [4] for one user with two candidates in each of weeks 101 and 102; correct query lengths are [2,2]. LightGBM itself was replaced by a capturing stub.
findings.recommendation: Sort and group by (target_week, customer_idx); enforce unique (week,user,item) rows and contiguous query groups.

findings.title: Smoke ingestion overwrites the main Bronze table
findings.evidence: --smoke-test limits input to 5000 rows but writes mode overwrite to the same lakehouse.bronze.transactions path as a full run.
findings.recommendation: Use a dedicated smoke data root; reject smoke writes to production paths. Version/preserve customer mapping when rerunning downstream jobs.

findings.title: Detector interprets COCO class IDs as fashion12 labels
findings.evidence: Default yolo11m.pt is COCO80. Mock outputs with class 0 person and 26 handbag are interpreted as top and other. Constructor device is not passed to predict.
findings.recommendation: Require checkpoint ontology metadata and verify model.names; use the correct YOLO-World class prompts or a verified fashion12 checkpoint, and pass device explicitly.

findings.title: Empty-history UserTower output contains NaN
findings.evidence: With an all-True history mask, all 64 output dimensions are NaN. Multiplying masked attention outputs by zero does not remove NaN.
findings.recommendation: Handle empty history before attention; use an explicit cold-start user fallback and test mixed and entirely empty batches.

findings.title: Dataclass contracts do not enforce their declared types and identity constraints
findings.evidence: Direct FashionEvent construction accepts invalid UUID/timestamps, customer_id x, event_type delete, source unknown, sales_channel_id 999 and NaN price. Qdrant payload permits product_code inconsistent with article prefix. FastAPI validation behavior was not tested.
findings.recommendation: Use consistent validated boundary schemas or explicit validation in every constructor; derive/check product prefix and require finite numeric values. Specify demo identities separately if supported.

findings.title: Kafka log storage is outside the mounted volume
findings.evidence: KAFKA_LOG_DIRS is absent. Apache Kafka image 3.9.0 wrapper uses the provided environment to construct server.properties; default log.dir is /tmp/kafka-logs, while the bind mount is /var/lib/kafka/data. Container recreation persistence was not exercised.
findings.recommendation: Set KAFKA_LOG_DIRS=/var/lib/kafka/data and validate produce -> recreate -> consume with retained messages and metadata.

findings.title: Historical replay and UI event clocks share one watermark
findings.evidence: Replay uses 2020 timestamps and UI uses current UTC time in the same fashion-events stream; a current event advances an event_time watermark beyond later historical records.
findings.recommendation: Separate replay/live topics, queries, checkpoints and Redis namespaces, or explicitly rebase the replay clock while preserving the historical date. Do not measure latency as now minus a historical event timestamp.

findings.title: Redis sessions have two writers and no retry deduplication contract
findings.evidence: API and Spark are both specified to update recent history. Redis pipeline is not deduplication, and foreachBatch is at-least-once. Window identity, snapshot replacement and expired-item removal are undefined for trend:15m.
findings.recommendation: Choose a single session writer or shared atomic event_id dedup. Specify idempotent window snapshots, checkpoint/run identity, retry and partial-failure tests.

findings.title: Model-selection data is not separated from final reporting
findings.evidence: Week104 is used for gates and early stopping without a separate final holdout. CV benchmark is Val in MASTER_PLAN but Test in ARCHITECTURE; Fashionpedia and VN development/final policies are not frozen.
findings.recommendation: Proposed, not adopted: keep Sep16..22 as untouched final, use an earlier week for dev and earlier weeks for train. Split Fashionpedia train/dev and VN queries by original image/person/outfit. Apply cutoff-specific candidates, models and features to each week.

findings.title: CV relevance and pooled-metric protocol is incomplete
findings.evidence: Same taxonomy is proposed for class filtering and CatConsistency, risking a tautological score. Gallery/qrels/self-match policy and GT-crop versus predicted-crop reporting are absent. nDCG defaults to each returned list's own relevance pool.
findings.recommendation: Freeze gallery/query/qrels, exclude I2I self-match, measure unfiltered class consistency, separate oracle-crop diagnostics from detector end-to-end results, and use a shared blinded union label pool with a common IDCG.

findings.title: Canonical plan, architecture and contracts disagree on integration interfaces
findings.evidence: Conflicting Silver partitions, feature-table paths, Qdrant collection/named-vector design, 5m versus 15m/1m windows, Redis customer_idx versus customer_id keys/TTLs, outfit method/path and third encoder identity.
findings.recommendation: Make DATA_CONTRACTS and validated schemas authoritative; align plan/config/prompts. Include primary keys, cutoff, model/snapshot versions, article/categorical index vocabularies, padding/OOV semantics and ownership.

findings.title: Resource claims are presented as measurements and FP16 policy conflicts with CPU serving
findings.evidence: Docs call VRAM/latency estimates actual and promise 100% fit, despite no measured artifacts. GPU features use FP32, not the documented FP16. NumPy fallback gathers all candidate vectors without batching; one 7M x 768 FP32 tensor is 21.504 GB before temporaries. CPU FP16 is not generally supported by ORT; requirements chooses CPU ORT while cv extra chooses GPU ORT. Colab SSH/resource statements are overbroad.
findings.recommendation: Label budgets as estimates and measured results TBD; benchmark peak process memory and concurrency; chunk both GPU and NumPy paths. Define per-model provider/dtype and export parity; use CPU FP32/validated INT8 as appropriate. Follow current Colab FAQ and record actual CU consumption.

findings.title: Quickstart and packaging do not produce a reproducible installed project
findings.evidence: README creates a venv then tests without dependency installation. Environment lacks key runtime libraries and pytest. Setuptools auto-discovery produces packages backend/contracts/cv/... under package_dir src, while imports use src.*; spark_jobs and external configs are omitted. Wheel import behavior not tested.
findings.recommendation: Choose one documented installation path, explicitly configure package/data discovery, lock a smoke-tested environment while preserving global torch/CUDA, and verify imports/config resolution from outside the checkout.

findings.title: White borders do not establish aspect-ratio correctness
findings.evidence: A synthetically stretched white-background portrait still passes the white-border heuristic. USE_DIRECTLY is too strong. Resize helper has no CLI, so executing its file does no processing; padding an already stretched image cannot reconstruct the original ratio.
findings.recommendation: Report heuristic/inconclusive status; compare matching original images and record source metadata. Add explicit batch input/output CLI using original aspect ratios. Result artifacts need seed and timestamp.

findings.title: Existing Qdrant collections are accepted without embedding compatibility checks
findings.evidence: ensure_collection returns whenever the name exists, without checking dimensions, distance or encoder revision. Switching 768D SigLIP to 512D CLIP fails later; different same-dimension models can silently mix incompatible spaces.
findings.recommendation: Version collections by encoder/preprocessing fingerprint, validate schema and swap an alias after indexing/evaluation.

findings.title: SigLIP text padding overrides pretrained preprocessing
findings.evidence: padding=True pads to the batch maximum instead of pretrained padding=max_length/max_length=64. Retrieval regression was not measured because Transformers/model is unavailable.
findings.recommendation: Use model-specific processor settings and pin tested versions; test a query alone and in a mixed-length batch before benchmarking.

findings.title: Candidate Recall consumes iterator ground truth twice
findings.evidence: Same ground truth gives 1.0 as a list and 0.0 as iter(['A']), although Iterable is accepted by the signature.
findings.recommendation: Materialize each ground-truth set once or explicitly restrict the input contract to reusable collections.

findings.title: Two-Tower ablations, cold-start and feature parity claims exceed implementation
findings.evidence: Implemented ablations are ID-only/ID+metadata/ID+metadata+visual, not the planned time-decay variant. History permutation changes eval vectors only at floating-point noise because no position/time input exists. All item modes require an ID embedding; no explicit OOV/content-only path. Reusing one LightGBM file does not guarantee parity between purchase-derived offline features and online click/session features.
findings.recommendation: Align ablations before training; define ID masking/content-only and empty-history fallbacks, cutoff-based cold-start cohorts, and shared feature semantics with offline/online parity fixtures.

findings.title: Status language overstates completeness and milestones defer integration too long
findings.evidence: API endpoints return empty results/accepted without real business operations, health does not check dependencies, and the stream job only declares a schema. These are planned but unimplemented work, not individual defects. Yet docs say production-ready/complete, baseline end-to-end is promised in week1 while serving is assigned week6, and all TBD must be replaced even for optional skipped branches.
findings.recommendation: Describe current scaffold truthfully; separate liveness/readiness and return explicit unavailable/not-implemented responses until wired. Deliver a small vertical slice early; choose one advanced branch and allow NOT_RUN/SKIPPED with reasons. Specify quantitative gate acceptance separately from experiment-entry criteria.

additional_metric_caveats.evidence: Single-category annotator ratings return kappa=1 although expected-agreement denominator is zero.
additional_metric_caveats.recommendation: Report undefined/NaN plus observed agreement and label distribution.

additional_metric_caveats.evidence: ndcg([1])=1.0 with default self-pool; shared pool [3,3,3,1] gives 0.06515852978097801.
additional_metric_caveats.recommendation: Require the common pool for cross-model VN comparisons.

recommended_order: Fix A01-A07 and add regression coverage before data/model runs.
Freeze A10-A12 evaluation and integration contracts before delegating implementation.
Resolve A08-A09 streaming semantics and validate restart/retry behavior.
Repair A14 setup and deliver an early baseline vertical slice.
Benchmark resource limits on a small sample, then full data; choose one advanced research branch.
probe_status: Confirmed current behavior; these are defect reproductions, not regression tests passing corrected behavior.
reviewed_source_sha256_note: Hashes identify the review input snapshot before adding the audit journal to STATE/HANDOFF; implementation files were not modified.
